snippet.title: XANNIBAN | Gameplay Trailer (DEMO OUT NOW!)
snippet.description:
DEMO OUT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2259580/XANNIBAN/
(Note: This trailer contains flashing / flickering lights & imagery.)

Evil has been unleashed. Don the Trespasser's suit as you dash across facilities, manage resources, and confine hostile machines to change the fate of humanity. Lure your foes into containment as a grim epidemic festers beneath the surface...

In XANNIBAN, you take the role of a squad member tasked with locating the founder of a rogue technology corporation. It's only when you step foot into the bowels of XANNI-CORP that you realize something sinister has taken ahold of the premises.

In this original point & click action horror game, you'll need to dash from room-to-room, manage resources, and lure autonomous machines into containment using the various tools at your disposal.

CREDITS: Apex - Voice of KINGF0X

Full Game Coming Soon
